_about: Dracula moveset flow (lane V64FLOW), read by FlowTable.cs. scope 'player' = only a fighter whose PlayerBrain is enabled (a human); the AI, the BalanceAuto bot and the MoveSheet harness are untouched; 'all' = everyone. enabled false or no file = the exact old behaviour. Timings are 60 Hz sim ticks (Recovery tick t: 1 = first tick after the active window; recovery lengths light 22, thrust 21, heavy 31, kick 25).

chain._about: Attack-to-attack cancels (player only). A queued attack (the press queue of cancel.json keeps a press alive through the move) starts at the first Recovery tick a row allows. First matching row wins (file order). from = move id | * | prefix pattern like light*; to = light | heavy | thrust | kick; earliest/latest = Recovery tick range (latest 0 = until the recovery ends); onHitOnly = only when the swing connected (hit, block or parry); chained = use the shorter chained wind-up where the move has one (light, heavy). replaceBuiltin true = these rows replace the V3 chain window (move-defs chain.window 18, same range for light>light and light>heavy). maxLinks = chain links per string (0 = no limit). Dodge presses always win over an attack press; dodge cancels stay in cancel.json.

lockOn._about: Target lock. Tab / middle mouse / gamepad R3 (JoystickButton9) toggles CameraRig.lockEnabled. Locked: the camera and the body face the target, WASD strafes around it (strafe clips), dodges are relative to it. Unlocked: free camera, the body faces the move direction, attacks go along the stick direction. pushAwayBreaks (V3: pushing away from the foe for 0.25 s drops the lock) and attackRelocks (V3: any attack re-locks) are OFF so the toggle is the only switch. guardFacesTarget keeps the guard arc on the target. range = metres; beyond it the body does not face the target. hud: a small square dot on the target chest + LOCK text + a short toast on toggle.

attack._about: Attack magnetism and turn tracking (player only). magnet: at the start of a swing, if the target is within maxDistance (metres, x fighter scale) and within maxAngleDeg of the swing intent (locked: the target line; unlocked: the held stick direction, else the current facing) the body snaps to the target over snapMs. turn: the body turns toward the swing direction at most windupDegPerSec / activeDegPerSec / recoveryDegPerSec (the active frames are the sticky ones). moves[] overrides per move (id, * or prefix pattern; -1 = inherit). Hit-stop freezes the turn. Without a snap the old V3 tracking was an unlimited exponential slerp (rate 10 per second).

dodge._about: Directional dodge (player only). PlayerBrain labels each dodge by the held direction relative to the locked target: forward / back / left / right (lock on) or free (lock off). Per direction: iframeStart/iframeEnd = i-frame tick range counted from the dodge's first tick (Duel.Resolve ignores hits while inside it), distance = metres travelled, stamina = cost; -1 = keep dodge.json. Which move plays (roll / sidestep / backstep) stays in dodge.json input.onKey. snapToAxes: a locked forward roll goes exactly at the target. Shipped numbers equal the current dodge.json + stamina.json values (roll 4..28 / 3.2 m / 24, sidestep 2..10 / 2.0 m / 8).

bot._about: V64P: the flow layer on the BalanceAuto bot (applyToBot true). FlowBot.cs makes the key presses a human would, the SAME DuelFighterFlow / FlowTable code paths do the rest (chain rows, magnetism, directional dodge i-frames, riposte key, cancel table). chainOnHit / chainOnWhiff = chance to press a follow-up when the recovery starts (x chainDecay per link already chained, maxLinks per string); wLight..wKick = relative weight of the follow-up type (only types with a chain row from that move and in reach); jitterTicks = random delay after the row's earliest tick; cancelChance = per incoming swing seen while in recovery, cancelLead* = ticks of the foe's wind-up left when the cancel is pressed, cancelGuardShare = guard instead of dodge; riposteChance + riposteReact* = take the riposte key after a parry, reaction in ticks; dir* = weights of the dodge direction label. Pitborn is never touched (scope 'player').

riposte._about: Riposte after a parry (the 90-tick riposte window of parry.json riposteWindowTicks). auto true = any strike press (F / LMB, G, T) inside the window plays the riposte (V3 / P5 behaviour); keys = a dedicated riposte key (B / gamepad B, JoystickButton1) that also works during the 8-tick parry recovery (the press waits). consume true = one riposte per parry. move = riposte | slash_riposte | heavy_riposte. hint shows the RIPOSTE text while the window is open.
